I've opened an issue in SDL's GitHub repository, I think it should help with fixing this bug
The issue has been put into SDL 3.4.0 milestone (current SDL release cycle versions are 3.2.XX), so I'm not sure this bug will be fixed before Godot 4.5 releases :(
We could make a local `.patch` to the relevant SDL scripts, but that's pretty solidly 4.5.1 territory at the earliest

> So we got some news from the creator of SDL on the issue:
> 
>     1. Slouken couldn't reproduce the issue with the pedal that was mentioned in the original post, it wasn't detected as a joystick and instead it generated the "B" key press;
> 
>     2. The webcam goncalo is using does show up as a joystick even in Windows settings, and the fix that will ignore this webcam in the joystick subsystem is now merged in SDL;
> 
>     3. The webcam reports that it has 256 buttons and some of them are pressed at the startup, so the webcam may have a broken HID descriptor.
> 
> 
> If anyone else can get Godot unresponsive when a joystick/gamepad is disconnected, please test [this build](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/108753#issuecomment-3271417773) and post the output here, it would be very helpful!
